data.description: Luxury Apartment | Charming Community | Prime Offer
data.display_address: DAMAC Maison de Ville Tenora, Dubai South (Dubai World Central), Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover Tenora, ideally situated in the heart of Dubai South, right near the dynamic Expo 2020 site. This prime location provides seamless access to Al Maktoum International Airport, Jebel Ali Port, and Dubai Metro, making it a central hub for both business and leisure. With easy connections via major roads—Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road (E311), Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), and Emirates Road (E611)—staying connected to the city has never been easier.


  Step into Tenora’s inviting lobby and be welcomed into a selection of stylish studios, as well as one and two-bedroom apartments. The modern interiors are designed for both functionality and comfort, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.


  Each apartment features a spacious, contemporary layout that allows you to enjoy your home to its fullest. With separate living and dining areas, hosting family, friends, or business associates is effortless. For overnight guests, a convenient sofa bed ensures they are comfortably accommodated, making Tenora truly feel like home.


  Experience the good life with a range of amenities designed to enhance your well-being. Tenora boasts state-of-the-art health and fitness clubs as well as luxurious swimming pools, catering to your health and relaxation needs.
